effect.$description: Tier 4 numeric shader parameters. Web outputs --effect-* CSS vars; Swift outputs EiDotterEffects.* constants.

phosphor.$description: Phosphor light-emission characteristics — the CRT pixel glow physics

intensity.$description: Overall phosphor brightness multiplier (0–1). Web: --retro-intensity CSS var; Apple: SwiftUI colorEffect shader uniform / Metal float.

persistence.$description: How long a glow lingers after change (50–800ms). Web: animation duration on glow fade; Apple: SwiftUI .easeOut animation duration or SKShader trailing uniform. Phase 0i Niels-derived (time-based segmentation).

glow-radius.$description: Tight phosphor glow around lit pixels (8–120px). Web: box-shadow inset blur; Apple: SwiftUI .shadow(radius:) or CIBloom input radius. Note: Apple/web don't use identical units — see Phase 0i unit-conversion note.

bloom-radius.$description: Soft phosphor halation extending outward (20–200px). Web: outer box-shadow inset blur; Apple: CIBloom larger pass.

bloom-intensity.$description: Phosphor halation visibility (0–1). Web: bloom layer opacity; Apple: CIBloom input intensity.

focus-blur.$description: Slight defocus from imperfect electron beam convergence (0–4px). Default 0 = perfectly focused. Phase 0i Niels-derived (oscilloscope FOCUS knob). Web: backdrop filter blur; Apple: CIGaussianBlur input radius.

intensity.$description: Scanline visibility (0–1). Web: scanline overlay opacity; Apple: SwiftUI shader UV-based dark-stripe modulation.

line-pitch.$description: Distance between scanlines (2–8px). Web: gradient repeat distance; Apple: shader UV period.

scroll-period.$description: Scanline drift cycle (2000–30000ms; 0 to disable). Web: animation duration; Apple: shader time-uniform multiplier.

flicker.$description: CRT flicker characteristics. WCAG 2.3.1 — period must be >=333ms (max 3Hz) to avoid seizure risk. Build-time enforcement via Style Dictionary range-clamp transform, per Phase 0j review.

intensity.$description: Flicker visibility (0–0.1). Web: flicker layer opacity; Apple: shader sine-wave modulation amplitude.

period.$description: Flicker cycle (333–1000ms; >=333ms = 3Hz max for WCAG 2.3.1). Hard floor at 333ms enforced by build-time transform. Web: animation duration; Apple: time-uniform period.

intensity.$description: Vignette visibility (0–1). Web: glow layer opacity; Apple: shader corner-darkening modulation.

spread.$description: Vignette spread as fraction of viewport (0–0.5). Web: gradient stop position (50% = ratio of inner safe area); Apple: shader UV-distance threshold.

web.$description: Web extension — CSS-implementation-specific knobs that don't translate to Apple platforms. Lives in Web DS only.

line-width.$description: Thin-line width in scanline gradient (web-only — Apple shader uses UV-fraction).

scroll-distance.$description: How far scanline overlay drifts before looping (web-only — Apple uses time-based UV scrolling).

steps.$description: CSS steps() discretization (web-only — Apple shader is continuous).

intensity-static.$description: Non-animated reduced-motion fallback opacity (web-only — Apple uses runtime accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion flag, not a token).

fade-stop.$description: CSS radial-gradient stop where bloom transparency begins (web-only — CIBloom has no gradient-stop equivalent).

gradient-extent-x.$description: CSS radial-gradient ellipse X size in % (web-only).

gradient-extent-y.$description: CSS radial-gradient ellipse Y size in % (web-only).

transition-edge.$description: Outer-edge gradient stop where deepest vignette begins (web-only).

scale-pre-collapse.$description: CSS transform: scale() start during power-off (web-only).

scale-collapse-line.$description: Thin horizontal line mid-state during collapse (web-only).

duration-off.$description: Web-only power-off animation duration. Apple platforms have own timing curves.
